text: Design a whole concrete frame in 3D, in minutes.
Meet Zeta Model Space, for NSCP 2015 and ACI 318.

title: Set the grid
text: Click Geometry, and type the bays and storey heights. Regenerate, and the frame is built: beams, columns and slabs.

title: Loads on the model
text: On Loading, generate the N S C P earthquake cases.

title: Analyse in seconds
text: On Analysis, run the 3D model. Then show the stress in every member.

title: Modes & periods
text: Run the modal analysis, for the periods and mass participation.

title: Instant pass / fail
text: Click Design structure. Fourteen columns fail, and each one shows why.

title: Optimise in one click
text: Click Optimise design. Sizes and bars are re-chosen, and every member passes.

title: See every bar
text: Turn on the reinforcement cages, and see every bar.

title: Plans, drawn for you
text: Open Plans. Framing plans and schedules, drawn for you.

title: One-click report
text: Click P D F, and download the full calculation report, every check shown step by step.

title: Opens in ETABS & STAAD
text: And under Exchange, export to E tabs, STAAD or Excel.
Start free, at Zeta struct dot app.
